run_sgld_sweep: run the sgld_sweep function to generate a sweep of SGMCMCConfig for vanilla SGLD
run_momentum_sgld_sweep: run the momentum_sgld_sweep function to generate a sweep of SGMCMCConfig for momentum SGLD
run_precondition_momentum_sgld_sweep: run the precondition_momentum_sgld_sweep function to generate a sweep with RMSprop preconditioner
run_mlp_sgd_sweep: run the mlp_sgd_sweep function to generate a sweep for MLP with SGD optimizer
run_paper_agent: run the paper_agent function to create a PaperAgent with combined sweep and default config
